associations.rationale: The displayed type constructs a module structure on M over the tensor product of the image algebras; it is infrastructure for, rather than a statement of, the no-loss/WLOG reduction.
The displayed type constructs the corresponding algebra homomorphism into End(M), but does not state that replacing A and B loses no information or yields the finite-dimensional WLOG reduction.
It verifies the pure-tensor action formula for the constructed representation, rather than stating the reduction itself.
